messages:
maya_devex: quick notes from today's design review 1: proposing a compact 'invoke timeline' in the playground run pane that groups tool-calls, surfaces a tiny schema pill, and exposes a one-tap diff expand. feedback?

leo_design: love compacting. can you paste a tiny ascii so I can check spacing on narrow widths? also microcopy ideas.

maya_devex: ascii mock:
[Assistant output]
• [S] TranslateText v2  b7 3 calls b7 avg 46ms b7 p95 150ms b7 Schema used bb
• [U] GetProfile  b7 1 call  b7 schema ok

omar_eng: engineering note: show avg + p95 inline; when user expands, lazy-load per-call timings and diffs. avoid fetching diffs for >20 calls by default.

nina_prod: preserve the schema snapshot used at runtime. do not rewrite history. add an opt-in CTA: "Re-run with latest schema" which reenacts parsing.

eli_a11y: accessibility nits: chips must be at least 2rem hit area, include visible focus ring, and aria-labels like "invoke group: TranslateText, 3 calls". badges need text + icon; contrast >= 4.5:1. keyboard: Tab into history, Arrow to chips, Enter expands, Esc closes. SR should announce "schema diff opened, 3 changes".

leo_design: copy tweaks: use "Schema used" for the snapshot pill, and "Schema changes" for the diff affordance. badges: "Structured" / "Unstructured". preserve expand state when paginating.

maya_devex: UX question: if many tools are called in one run, collapse to a "+N more" summary and show first two tools + "+8 more". expand reveals full list.

omar_eng: perf note: implement a render cap and a streaming diff endpoint for big runs. also add avg+p95 so we don't need full lists by default.

ci-bot: deploy-checks: please add unit tests for 0/1/many tool-calls, extremely long tool ids, keyboard navigation E2E, and lazy-load behavior. missing tests will fail CI. :robot_face:

maya_devex: action items I captured: 1) invoke timeline with structured/unstructured pill + name + counts + timing + diff affordance; 2) per-run schema snapshot + lazy diffs; 3) preserve expand state across pages; 4) keyboard + ARIA + contrast compliance; 5) "+N more" collapse for long lists; 6) reenact CTA; 7) CI tests for edge cases. will update the prototype and post screenshots here. thanks everyone :tada:
